meta.note: preview camera of the contact sheets: eye position relative to the model origin (Blender axes x right, y forward, z up). Rest pose = hammer cocked, finger on the trigger. Slide locked back = node Slide moved slide_lock_m towards the shooter (glTF +Z), Hammer rotated hammer_over_deg further back, Barrel tilted barrel_tilt_deg and 3 mm back, SlideStop raised 3 deg; ReloadEmpty goes there within its first 2 frames. MagRounds (child of Magazine) is scaled away for the empty magazine in ReloadEmpty. Sprint is a seamless loop in a compressed high-ready pose (muzzle up, close to the chest) (cross-fade into it).
